groups.label: Selection
groups.help: What counts as bright, and at which region sizes the budget is enforced.

groups.label: Budget
groups.help: Allowed mean brightness versus the size of the bright area.

groups.label: Response
groups.help: How the required dimming is applied.

groups.label: Timing
groups.help: How fast dimming engages and releases.

groups.label: Treated-area color
groups.help: Color recipe applied only where the guard is dimming, scaled by how hard it dims and by time of day. Stacks on top of f.lux. Bypass turns it off too.

groups.label: Sun schedule
groups.help: Time-of-day phases used when Treated-area color is set to Sun schedule.

groups.label: Debug view
groups.help: Visualisations drawn on the real desktop.

params.label: Bright threshold
params.help: Linear luminance at which a pixel starts counting toward the budget. 0.2 linear is roughly 48% grey.

params.label: Threshold softness
params.help: Pixels ramp from not-bright at the threshold to fully bright at threshold + softness.

params.label: Finest scale
params.help: Smallest neighbourhood checked (pyramid level). 0 = per pixel (sharp, but ghosts on scroll in overlay mode).

params.label: Coarsest scale
params.help: Largest neighbourhood checked. The top level is the whole monitor.

params.label: Spread
params.help: Grows each dimmed region outward by N cells so the fade happens in the dark surroundings rather than inside the bright area (prevents vignettes).

params.label: Budget vs area
params.help: x: bright-area size as log10 of the monitor fraction. y: max allowed mean linear luminance (1 = full white). Left end = highlight ceiling, right end = whole-screen budget.

params.label: Strength
params.help: Mix between no filtering (0) and the full computed dimming (1).

params.label: Gain floor
params.help: Never dim any pixel below this fraction of its original light.

params.label: Selective
params.help: Apply dimming only where bright pixels are (by mask coverage), instead of dimming the whole neighbourhood. Dark content next to bright areas keeps its brightness.

params.label: Selective scale
params.help: Resolution of the selective mask. 0 = per pixel (exact, but ghosts while scrolling in overlay mode); 3 = 8px cells (smooth).

params.label: Selective grow
params.help: Grow the selective mask outward by N cells so the edges of bright areas get the full dimming (removes the light rim).

params.label: Protect darks
params.help: Exempt pixels darker than the dark floor from dimming. Per-pixel, so it can ghost while scrolling in overlay mode.

params.label: Dark floor
params.help: Linear luminance below which Protect darks applies.

params.label: Attack
params.help: Time constant for dimming down. 0 = instant (recommended).

params.label: Release
params.help: Time constant for brightening back up once content gets darker.

params.label: Color
params.help: Quick A/B switch for the treated-area color.

params.label: Temperature
params.help: Warmth of the recipe, relative to neutral (6500 K = none). Stacks on top of f.lux.

params.label: Blue cut
params.help: Extra reduction of the blue channel on top of the temperature.

params.label: Green cut
params.help: Reduce green too. Blue + green at 100% gives a red-only 'astronomy' mode.

params.label: Saturation
params.help: 0 = greyscale. Applied before the warmth, so desaturated treated areas look uniformly warm.

params.label: Brightness
params.help: Extra dimming of treated areas, on top of the guard.

params.label: Full color at
params.help: Dimming amount (1 - gain) that gets the full recipe. Lightly dimmed areas get proportionally less.

params.label: When
params.help: Sun schedule: Day / Evening / Late amounts below follow the clock (or Simulate time). Always: full recipe at all times, clock ignored.

params.label: Day amount
params.help: Sun schedule: how much of the recipe applies during the day.

params.label: Evening amount
params.help: Sun schedule: from sunset.

params.label: Late amount
params.help: Sun schedule: from bedtime until wake time.

params.label: Detail
params.help: 100% = exact per-pixel color (crisp text; faint fringes while scrolling in overlay mode). 0% = smooth (no fringes, but dark text in treated areas gets a slight haze).

params.label: Bedtime
params.help: Sun schedule: when the late temperature starts. Values past 24 mean after midnight.

params.label: Wake time
params.help: Sun schedule: late ends; daytime starts at the later of wake time and sunrise.

params.label: Transition
params.help: Sun schedule: length of each fade (f.lux 'slow' is 60 min).

params.label: Simulate time
params.help: Testing only: drive the schedule from the slider below instead of the clock. Never saved to profiles.

params.label: Simulated time
params.help: Testing only: time of day used while Simulate time is On.

params.label: Latitude
params.help: For sunrise/sunset. Click the value to type.

params.label: Longitude
params.help: For sunrise/sunset (west is negative).

params.label: View
params.help: Overlay visualisation on the real desktop.
